title: GitHub
summary: GitHub's official MCP server: repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, security alerts and more.
description: github/github-mcp-server v2.0.3 (MIT), installed from its signed release archive and run locally as `github-mcp-server stdio` with a GitHub personal access token from agentd's vault. The tool list is every tool in the v2.0.3 source, including toolsets and feature-flagged tools that are off by default; tools that delete, merge or change rulesets always ask. The embedded server.json is the official MCP Registry entry for 2.0.3, unchanged; its OCI package waits for the oci runtime (MK2).
